text.tspan: 2. read tools; check_task on the proposed draft
3. at most two numbered questions, then a preview
with the checks (the model is offered no request tool)
policy engine; draft gate: a fail-closed webhook covers UPDATE fleettasks?
9. fleetops approve <id>: create ApprovalDecision with own credentials
10. checks: requester not unverified (D56: a request without a verified token, e.g. from the web UI, is refused here);
decider != requester; SubjectAccessReview (decider may create fleettasks);
not expired; policy re-run on fresh state; status Approved, approvedBy
11. check_task again on fresh state; dry runs of the FleetTask and each member
12. create FleetTask spec.draft: true, deterministic name

g.text: 14. 'activate it': the same questions, preview and confirmation

text.tspan: 19. fleetops activate <request> with own credentials (any person Swarmada lets activate):
refuses a ServiceAccount; check_task with the caller's reads; records an ApprovalDecision
of type Activation; sends the merge patch {"spec":{"draft":false}}
20. watch: task left Draft -> links the Activation record (activatedBy),
status Executed, ActivationObserved Event, activation_observed audit line;
then watches to a terminal phase and records the outcome
